'''Siva Ramachandran Athreya''' (born 1971) is an Indian [[Probability theory|probability theorist]] specialising in [[Statistical mechanics|statistical physics]] and [[population biology]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Siva Athreya|url=http://www.icts.res.in/people/8/details/57/|publisher=Tata Institute of Fundamental Research|access-date=1 July 2013}}</ref>

He graduated in mathematics from [[St. Stephen's College, Delhi|St Stephen's College, Delhi]], went to the [[Indian Statistical Institute]] in Kolkata and Bangalore where he completed his master's, and obtained his PhD degree from the [[University of Washington]] in 1998 under the supervision of Krzysztof  Burdzy.<ref>{{cite web|title=Science Elite 11|url= http://archive.indianexpress.com/news/how-they-made-science-s-elite-xi/1010484/0}}</ref> He was awarded the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]] in 2012, the highest science award in India, in the mathematical sciences category.<ref>{{cite web|title=Bhatnagar Prize Awardees 2012|url=http://csirhrdg.res.in/ssb2012_awardees.pdf|publisher=CSIR, New Delhi|access-date=1 July 2013}}</ref>

He has co-written the book, "Probability and Statistics with Examples using R" (along with Deepayan Sarkar and Steve Tanner).
